lines: Anyone will do, anyone at all, isn't there someone?
It was no voice, but I felt two glaring gazes were present.
With this, farewell; from the curse, farewell. The night broke.
It was curiosity, towards the other side of the barbed wire.
When a butterfly flew in, I said I had no interest at all.
To say it was just as I had longed for would be a lie.
It was decadent; I spilled the coffee foam.
In such a daily life as that, before me,
you appeared.
No matter what I do, I still cannot move forward.
To the nature of this hippie town,
how, how can I find a reason?
"Everything is important"—it sounds good, but.
We suddenly appeared from the other side, and before we knew it, we were about to be taken away.
Fearing to let go, you stay put again today.
I am indebted to you all, to you all.
I have no recollection, but you wear such a face as if you have much to say.
Everything reflected in my eyes, everything present here, was fake.
Whether I give in to emotion or throw it all away, it begins now.
If you just bite your tongue and stay silent there,
to say it was just as I had longed for would be a lie.
It was sentimental; it was not like you.
Such an expression, for a moment, in my eyes,
appeared beautiful.
I had always admired you somewhere, and each time I was on the verge of losing myself.
Surpass the real thing. If you get scared, you stay put again today.
